_comment: Owner decision D-9 (2026-10-26): the LiquidStakingPool is retired at the r1006 reroll and is not in the genesis contract set. Citrate Core makes no pool calls and offers no pool self-stake. The tripwires (src/wallet/lspRetired.tripwire.test.ts and src-tauri/src/lsp_retired_tests.rs) fail on any of these strings in the scanned trees. One list for both, so they cannot drift.

allowReasons.src/shell/state.ts: RETIRED_KEYS names the key a 0.5.1 save may still carry, so loadState drops it.
allowReasons.src/agent/eval/qa-v1.json: A hashed eval dataset of questions over the public docs (TreasuryGovernor voting power); not a pool call.

_persistedKeysComment: Keys a 0.5.1 save (or a 0.5.2 pre-release save) may still carry for the pool. loadState drops them; they never reach AppState.
